note: All conditions must hold. The first that fails is recorded. Requirement F124-FR-038.

conditions.holds: the harness supports the critic role
the form is tool-less by construction, or the harness has a tested harness adapter; an unverified harness of kind cli never qualifies
harness-native memory is off or absent
the context window is known and large enough
provider or model differs from the proposer's
the credential is present and the free preflight gave no auth failure
the terms gate allows the provider on a row
not known to be out of quota at launch
a budget is in force; for the cost class metered the hard cap is set
for the form read-only-tools the read denial of the withheld paths is confirmed
